supported_input: generic PointCloud2 lidar_type=0 + RGB image + IMU, GPS=false,HILTI=false

overflow_policy: explicit failure, no overwrite, no IMU thinning

raw_diagnostic_receipt: original receive-entry steady clock, never owner dequeue
